2 • illimité, nombreux, infiniment; limitless; numerously; endlessly}. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

3 • autant que possible, jusqu'à, tout juste, la fin de, la terminaison, la conclusion; the termination of; the conclusion; just to the limit of; as far as possible; all of; the finish; the end of; up to. Miɗo yiɗi nyiɓanaa kam haddi cuuɗi ɗiɗi. J'aimerais que tu me construises tout juste deux maisons. I would like you to build me just two houses. Si caara nanngii na'i maa, imo waawi hantude haddu na'i maa fuu nde wootere. Si la peste infect tes bœufs, cela peut attendre finalement tous tes bœufs. If rinderpest infects you cows, it can finish [up to] all of you cows at one time. Mi gollii haddi ko mbaawmi fay si hewtaay ko njiɗumi. J'ai travaillé si dur que j'ai pu, même si cela n'était pas autant que j'avais voulu. I worked as hard as I could, even if it wasn't as much as I wanted to. synonyms: kaddi. Dialectal Forms: [J,Y,G,M] haddi. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

harminde   Note for Verb Stative or Progressive: Note: a Pullo tends to think of this concept of forbidding in a slightly different way than we. Because of this he can say, "Baabam na harmini (mi yara doro)." meaning "My father is in a state of forbidding/rejecting my using drugs." or he can say, "Baabam na harmina mi yara doro." meaning "My father continually forbids me to use drugs." [i.e. speaks with me repeatedly] or he can say "Baabam harminii mi yara doro." meaning "My father forbade me to use drugs." [with the continued forbidding implied].. Noun Form of Infinitive: harmingol. Participles: sing: karminɗo-karminoowo plur: harminɓe-harminooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3, th. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: st/prg. Verb. 1 • interdire car faux / mauvais ou péché; forbid as wrong. Laamɗo harminii zeenu Dieu interdit la débauche sexuelle. God forbids sexual immorality. Baabam harminii mi yara doro. Mon père m'interdit de boire de la bière. My father forbids me to drink beer. Be careful how you use this sense because it is not exactly used in a phrase the way we would use it in English, e.g. you would NOT say "Baabam harminii kam mi yara doro." because "mi yara doro" is the object of the verb not "kam." ***: soƴƴude, haɗude; compare: haɗude. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • rejeter, repousser; reject. Baabiiko harminii o Son père l'a rejeté. His father has rejected him [and continues to reject him up to the present]. compare: saƴƴude. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

huyfude   Noun Form of Infinitive: huyfugol. Participles: sing: kuyfuɗo plur: huyfuɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: st. Verb. 1 • ne pas travailler, être paresseux; lazy (to be); not work. Maani wo kuyfuɗo. Un tel est paresseux. Whatishisname is lazy. ***: waamude, jaasude, hoyfude, yanude1, teddude; synonyms: jaasude, yanude1. Dialects: Y,G,M.

2 • ne pas être respecté ou honoré par d'autres; to not have honor or respect from others; O huyfii sabo o wujjii girow kaananke Il n'est pas respecté parce qu'il a volé le cochon du roi. He is not respected because he stole the king' pig. Dialects: Y,G,M.

3 • être léger; light (to be). Tummbude maa na huyfi sabo waldaa e kosam. Ta calebasse est légère parce que tu n'as pas de lait dedans. Your calabash is light because it has not milk in it. synonyms: hoyfude; compare: teddude. Dialects: Y,G,M.

huyinnde   Verb. exciter, motiver; stir up; kindle; motivate.

huylaade   Noun Form of Infinitive: huylagol. Participles: sing: kuyliiɗo-kuylotooɗo plur: huyliiɓe-huylotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. synonyme: yillude. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: st/prg. Verb. 1 • être perdu ou désorienté; lost (to be). ***: winaade, wemmbeede, lallude; synonyms: lallude, winaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • amnésique, s'endormir pour un cour moment, s'assoupir; doze; fall asleep for a few minutes. synonyms: surɓaade. Dialects: G.

huylagol   Plural Form of Noun: yillugol. Noun. amnésie; amnesia. Catégorie : Maladie.

huylitaade   Noun Form of Infinitive: huylitagol. Participles: sing: kuylitiiɗo-kuylitotooɗo plur: huylitiiɓe-huylitotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. 1 • retrouver les repères quand perdu; find your bearings when lost. ***: koyɗol, surɓaade, wintaade, ɗaanaade, ŋoŋude, hoyɗude; synonyms: wintaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • s'assoupir et rêver, être désorienté et confus après sommeil; to doze off and have a dream; to be disoriented and confused after having awaken from sleep or having been unconscious. compare: surɓaade, hoyɗude, koyɗol, ŋoŋude. Dialects: J.

huynude   Verb. crier pour chasser les animaux; cry to chase animals away.

huynugol   Noun. motivation; motivation.

huyre   Noun Class Markers: sing: nde plur: ɗe. Number One for this noun: wootere. Plural Form of Noun: kuƴe, kuse. Sorting Designation: 3, at, pl. synonyme: adala, giiniwol-ɓanndu. Noun. 1 • noyau du fruit «prune noire»; pit of the Sclerocarya birrea ("eedi") fruit. Dialects: J,Y,M.

2 • muscle, viande, chair; flesh; meat; muscle. Catégorie : Le corps. ***: adala; synonyms: teewu. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

huyude   Noun Form of Infinitive: huyugol. Participles: sing: kuyuɗo-kuyoowo plur: huyuɓe-huyooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3, th. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. être heureux / content, célébrer; celebrate; joyful. compare: kuyam; ***: weltaade, kuyam, jartinde, janjinde; synonyms: janjinde, weltaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

huywude   Noun Form of Infinitive: huywugol. Participles: sing: kuywuɗo-kuywoowo plur: huywuɓe-huywooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: h/k. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. lorsqu’un objet submergé revient à la surface et flotte; for a submerged object to resurface and float on the water; Si jaawleeje na ɓuri balɗe jeegom fuu kuymban; si kese, ndiƴƴan. Les œufs de pintade qui ont plus de six jours flottent, des nouveaux immergent, ou bien? Guinea-fowl eggs that are more than six days old float; new ones sink? ***: weeyude, royude; synonyms: royude, weeyude. Dialectal Forms: [J] huymbude. Dialects: Y,M.
